function.name: info
function.description: Get specific system information as a number. Use ONLY when a specific numeric type is requested. Type selects info category (0=product,1=firmware version,2=interface,3=mode).

function.name: reset
function.description: Reset device. mode defines reset behavior (0=normal reset,1=wipe firmware).

function.name: version
function.description: Get FULL detailed version information as a string (recommended). Includes firmware version, product id, pid and all details. Use this for general version queries like 'version', 'full version', 'detail', 'info'.
